step1_hero.prompt:
Image 1 is the front of a garment photographed flat on a headless mannequin. Image 2 is a macro of the same garment's neckline, fabric and print.

Task: produce a studio e-commerce hero photograph of a real human model wearing this exact t-shirt. Remove the mannequin entirely.

MODEL: young adult woman, mid-20s, warm light skin, long loose wavy dark-brown hair parted in the middle, minimal natural makeup, relaxed closed-lip smile, looking straight into the lens. Standing upright and square-on to camera, arms hanging relaxed at her sides, weight even on both feet.

STYLING: the tee from Image 1 worn untucked over light-blue straight-leg denim jeans and clean white leather low-top sneakers. No jewellery, no bag, no other accessories.

SET: seamless warm beige-cream studio backdrop, soft even large-softbox frontal light, subtle contact shadow under the shoes, no harsh shadows on the backdrop.

CAMERA: full-body head-to-toe framing, model centred, eye-level, 85mm lens look, small even margin above the head and below the shoes.

MUST PRESERVE EXACTLY from the references, unchanged: the cream / off-white fabric colour; the oversized boxy fit with dropped shoulder seams, short wide sleeves and a straight hem falling to upper thigh; the ribbed crew neckline; and the chest print — an orange spiky sun above the two-line retro serif wordmark "Summer Daze" in light blue — including its exact shape, letterforms, proportion, colours, centred position on the chest and the soft screen-print texture sitting on cotton jersey. Do not redraw, restyle, recolour, resize or reposition the print. Do not add any extra text, logo or graphic anywhere on the garment.

Photorealistic fashion e-commerce photography, natural skin texture, true-to-life cotton jersey, sharp focus throughout, no motion blur.
